step1_analysis.description: A high-speed differential amplifier (Current Mode Logic buffer) with an active tail current source. The tail current is precisely controlled by an operational amplifier in a negative feedback loop that forces the voltage across the source degeneration resistor to match a reference voltage derived from a resistor divider.

paper_reference.title: A 40–43-Gb/s Clock and Data Recovery IC With Integrated SFI-5 1:16 Demultiplexer in SiGe Technology

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the amplifier stage.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled down to a single stage in 1.8V SKY130 CMOS. The paper's 7.5W is for the entire high-speed IC.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm * Rload. gm ≈ 10mS at 1mA branch current. Gain = 10mS * 300 ohm = 3 V/V = 9.5 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical gain for a single-stage high-speed CML buffer designed for wide bandwidth.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW ≈ 1 / (2 * pi * Rload * Cload). With Rload=300 and Cload=10fF + parasitics (~20fF), BW ≈ 26 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: SKY130 NMOS fT is around 40 GHz, so a single stage can achieve 10-20 GHz bandwidth with low load capacitance, lower than the 120-GHz SiGe process.

sky130_expected.calculation: I_tail * Rload = 2mA * 300 ohm = 0.6V single-ended, or 1.2V differential peak-to-peak (max). For 0.2V diff input, output is ~0.6V diff.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on input swing and gain, limited by I_tail * Rload to keep transistors in saturation.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC gain, -3dB bandwidth, and transient output swing of the CML amplifier.
step3_testbench.spice:
* CML Amplifier Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_diff=20u L_diff=0.15u
.param W_tail=40u L_tail=0.15u
.param R_load=300 R_tail=300

* Power Supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* AC Coupled Inputs (Differential 1V AC, 0.2V peak transient)
VIN_AC IN_AC 0 DC 0 AC -0.5 SIN(0 0.1 100MEG 180 0)
VIP_AC IP_AC 0 DC 0 AC 0.5 SIN(0 0.1 100MEG 0 0)
CIN IN_AC IN 1u
CIP IP_AC IP 1u

* Circuit Netlist (NPNs mapped to NMOS)
R1 N2 VDD 1
R2 IN N2 50
R3 N4 VDD {R_load}
R4 IP N2 50
R5 VDD N6 10k
R6 N6 0 5k
R7 VDD N9 {R_load}
XM1 N4 IP N8 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_diff} L={L_diff}
R8 N3 0 {R_tail}
XM3 N8 N10 N3 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_tail} L={L_tail}
XM2 N9 IN N8 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_diff} L={L_diff}
E1 N10 0 N6 N3 1000

* Load Capacitors
CL1 N4 0 10f
CL2 N9 0 10f

* Differential Output and Input for Measurement
E_out_diff OUT_DIFF 0 N4 N9 1
E_in_diff IN_DIFF 0 IP IN 1

.control
  * DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 50 1MEG 100G
  let gain_db = vdb(OUT_DIFF)
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10MEG
  let gain_3db = dc_gain - 3
  meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=gain_3db fall=1

  * Transient Analysis
  tran 10p 30n
  meas tran vout_max max v(OUT_DIFF)
  meas tran vout_min min v(OUT_DIFF)
  let swing = vout_max - vout_min
  print swing

  quit
.endc
.end
